## Checklist

- [ ] `python tools/build.py` run, generated files committed
- [ ] `python tools/lint.py library/.../MY-ID.md` passes at **17/20 or better**
- [ ] Scored the four judgement criteria (Context, Action, Result/Format,
      Right-sized) myself, and the `score` block reflects that
- [ ] Checked `catalogue.json` - this is not a duplicate of an existing prompt
- [ ] Worked example is **concrete and synthetic** - no real names, case numbers,
      figures or extracts from real work
- [ ] Keeps the de-identification instruction and the no-invention rule with its
      `[TBC]` / `[PROPOSED — VALIDATE]` flags
- [ ] Portable - no employer, sector, named legislation or jurisdiction-specific
      rules; project specifics are `[MARKED PLACEHOLDERS]`
